notes_en: Fix: Quran reader showed a blank/empty screen when opening a surah. The page only rendered a full-screen spinner for the entire network request (the VPS is often down/filtered, so this could last the full ~90s timeout). Now seeds sample ayahs immediately and renders the list with a thin progress bar while loading; real data replaces it on success, sample stays on failure. Screen is never blank.
notes_ur: درست: قرآن ریڈر کا خالی اسکرین۔ اب سیمپل آیات فوراً دکھتی ہیں۔
notes_hi: Fix: Quran reader blank screen. Ab sample ayahs turant dikhte hain loading par.
